tools.name: aggregate_endpoint
tools.description: Get statistical aggregations for market analysis. Billed per aggregate value returned. Aggregations: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, quantile-10, quantile-25, quantile-40, quantile-60, quantile-75, quantile-80, quantile-85, quantile-90, quantile-95, quantile-99. Text and boolean fields onl

tools.name: auth_endpoint
tools.description: Check that an API key exists and is enabled. Does not bill per call. Returns api_key_authorized boolean. It does not check the key's maximum monthly spend, so a billed tool can still refuse a key that passes here.

tools.name: field_detail
tools.description: Describe fields by name: type, accepted filter values, its source column if it has one, filtered, aggregated or predicted, which expand set it belongs to, its price per value returned, and its full description. Does not bill per call. Coverage differs by country, and the server instructions say how

tools.name: field_list
tools.description: List the name of every public property data field, one per line. Does not bill per call. Pass filter to list only the names that contain a piece of text, for example score_, demographic_, assessment, permit or expand_listing. Follow with field_detail for each field's type, accepted filter values, ag

tools.name: geocoding_endpoint
tools.description: Find properties near coordinates (reverse geocoding). Billed per value returned. Required: latitude, longitude. Optional: radius (km), shape (circle/square). This endpoint has no country, province, city, community or address parameters. To narrow by place, put filters such as country_abbreviation_eq

tools.name: location_endpoint
tools.description: Get the places Houski holds property data for, as a hierarchy of countries, provinces (or states or regions), cities and communities, with links and slugs. tools.name: map_endpoint
tools.description: Get map data: pins, clusters, or heatmaps. Billed per cluster or heatmap cell returned, or per value returned for pins. Scope it with all four bbox coordinates or a polygon: with neither, every property in every country is in scope. A heatmap needs all four bbox coordinates, and a heatmap scoped by

tools.name: predict_endpoint
tools.description: Predict property values over time. Billed per predicted value, which is one field on one date for one property. Required: property_id, start_date, fields. Find the property_id first with search_endpoint or properties_endpoint. Supports batch requests and parameter overrides for scenario testing.

tools.name: properties_endpoint
tools.description: Retrieve property data (hundreds of fields) with filtering, sorting, and expansion. Billed per value returned: each selected field's price for each home that has a value for it, so a field with no value for a home is not billed. Always set select= to limit fields. tools.name: search_api_documentation
tools.description: Access API documentation pages for filter syntax, field references, and endpoint details. Does not bill per call. Pass an unknown page to get the full list of pages back.

tools.name: search_endpoint
tools.description: Find property_id using fuzzy address matching. Billed per value returned. Handles typos, abbreviations, partial addresses. Pass country_abbreviation to keep every match in one country. Use returned property_id with other endpoints for detailed data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth_endpoint" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
